clusters.headline: South Korea Imposes Stricter Penalties Following AI Exam Scandal
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Han Seong-sook ordered a comprehensive investigation into reports of cheating on state-administered examinations.
Proposed measures include distributing 8,000 metal detectors and implementing 10-year bans for students caught using AI-assisted technology.

aiSummaryBullets: The Democratic Party aims to initiate an impeachment motion against the Supreme Court chief justice on December 3.
The planned action follows the Supreme Court's decision to order a retrial for former Prime Minister Han regarding his martial law role.

clusters.headline: Stray Kids Member Felix Promotes South Korea Hanbok Campaign
aiSummaryBullets: Stray Kids member Felix modeled traditional hanbok designs for the South Korean government's annual Hanbok Wave initiative.
The campaign aims to promote South Korean cultural identity as the government prepares for new legislation to grow the domestic hanbok industry.

clusters.headline: South Korean Fair Trade Watchdog Fines 15 Firms For Bond Collusion
aiSummaryBullets: Fifteen bond dealers have been penalized 1.6 trillion won for colluding on government bond bidding processes.
The decision was issued by the South Korean Fair Trade Commission following an investigation into market rigging practices.

clusters.headline: Nvidia Maintains GPU Supply Commitments To South Korea Post-Huang
aiSummaryBullets: Nvidia has maintained its commitment to supply South Korea with graphics processing units.
The assurance follows the resignation of Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang.

clusters.headline: Ateez Reaches Fourth Billboard 200 Top Spot With New Album Release
aiSummaryBullets: The K-pop group Ateez achieved their fourth No. 1 on the Billboard 200 chart with their latest release.
The group's 15th EP, titled Golden Hour: Part. 6, reached the top position shortly after their previous release.

aiSummaryBullets: Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix shares recorded significant losses during Friday trading on the Korea Exchange.

clusters.headline: South Korea Wins Men's Relay Gold At Short Track World Tour Event
aiSummaryBullets: South Korean skaters claimed the gold medal in the men's 5,000-meter relay at the International Skating Union Short Track World Tour.
The winning team, comprised of Shin Dong-min, Kim Tae-sung, Lee Jeong-min, and Rim Jong-un, outperformed skaters from the Netherlands and Canada.
